Age.

You must be at least 18 years old and competent to contract under the Indian Contract Act, 1872 to create an account. By creating an account, you confirm that you meet this requirement. If we learn that an account belongs to a person under 18, we may suspend or close it.
Minors as passengers or recipients.

A Customer may book a Ride or Package Delivery for another person, including a minor, only if the Customer takes full responsibility for that booking. A minor below 18 years must not travel alone on a Ride, and a minor must never be the only passenger on a bike Ride. The Service Partner may refuse a booking that does not meet these conditions.
Registration.

To use the Services, you must register with a valid Indian mobile number, your name and, where requested, your email address and a password. We verify your mobile number by one-time password. You must provide accurate, current and complete information and keep it up to date.
One account.
You may hold only one Customer account. Accounts are personal and must not be shared, sold or transferred.
Account security.

You are responsible for all activity on your account. You must keep your password, one-time passwords and device secure and tell us immediately at support@adios.one if you suspect unauthorised use. Further rules are in the Terms of Use.
Booking for someone else.

When you place an Order for another person (for example, a Ride for a family member or a Package Delivery to a recipient), you confirm that you have their permission to share their name, contact number and address with us and with the Service Partner, and that you will inform them of these Terms and of our Privacy Policy. You remain responsible for the Order, including payment.
Technology platform.
Adios operates a technology platform that connects Customers with Merchants and with Service Partners. Unless we expressly say otherwise for a particular service:
the food and meat products you order are sold to you by the Merchant, not by Adios;
Rides, Package Deliveries, food and meat deliveries and Helper Bookings are performed by independent Service Partners, who are not employees or agents of Adios;
Adios facilitates discovery, ordering, payment collection, dispatch, tracking, communication and customer support.
Payment collection.

Where you pay through the Adios App, Adios (or its payment gateway) collects the payment on behalf of the Merchant and/or Service Partner as their limited agent for receiving payment, and also collects any fees charged by Adios itself. Payment to Adios discharges your payment obligation to the Merchant or Service Partner for that Order.
Seller information.

For every Merchant, we display the details we are required to display under the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020, including the Merchant's name, address and, for food businesses, its FSSAI licence or registration number. You can find these on the Merchant's page in the Adios App.
Our responsibilities.
Although Merchants and Service Partners are independent, Adios will:
display accurate Order information and the total Charges before you confirm an Order;
verify Merchants and Service Partners at onboarding as described in Section 14;
provide customer support and a grievance redressal mechanism (Section 20);
process refunds that are due under these Terms;
take action against Merchants and Service Partners who breach our standards.

5.1 The Services are available only in the cities and zones we serve from time to time (currently Tadepalligudem, Andhra Pradesh), and within each service's operating hours. Availability can vary with demand, weather, traffic, Merchant opening hours and the number of Service Partners online.

5.2 We do not guarantee that any Merchant will accept your Order, that a Service Partner will be found for your Ride, Package Delivery or Helper Booking, or that an Order will be completed within an estimated time. Delivery, arrival and trip times shown in the Adios App are estimates only.
5.3 If we cannot find a Service Partner within the search period, we will cancel the search, tell you, and refund any online payment in full under Section 12.
Scheduled Orders.

Some Merchants accept Orders scheduled for a later time. A scheduled Order is confirmed only when the Merchant accepts it in the Adios App. If the Merchant declines, you will be notified and will not be charged.
Listings.

Menus, item descriptions, photographs, prices, packaging charges, veg/non-veg markers, portion sizes and availability are provided by the Merchant. We take reasonable care to display them accurately, but the Merchant is responsible for them. Photographs are for illustration and the actual product may differ in presentation.
Placing an Order.

An Order is an offer by you to buy the listed items from the Merchant at the price shown at checkout. A contract of sale is formed between you and the Merchant only when the Merchant accepts the Order in the Adios App. If the Merchant does not accept within the acceptance window, the Order is cancelled automatically and any online payment is refunded in full.
Special instructions.
Cooking or packaging instructions are passed to the Merchant and followed on a best-effort basis. We cannot guarantee that they will be followed.
Allergens and dietary information.

If you have an allergy or dietary requirement, contact the Merchant or our support team before ordering. Neither Adios nor the Merchant can guarantee that food is free from allergens unless the listing expressly says so. Veg/non-veg markers are provided by the Merchant.
Food safety.

Merchants must hold valid FSSAI licences or registrations and comply with the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and its regulations. Food is prepared and packed by the Merchant. Once delivered, consume or refrigerate it promptly.
Meat orders.
For raw meat, poultry, fish and similar perishable products:

products are sold by weight or by pack. Because natural products cannot always be cut to an exact weight, the delivered weight of a cut item may vary from the ordered weight within a tolerance of 5%. If the shortfall exceeds the tolerance, you may claim a refund of the difference under Section 13;
Merchants must keep perishable products at safe temperatures and pack them hygienically for delivery;
please check the product on delivery and refrigerate it immediately. We are not responsible for spoilage caused by storage after delivery;
substitutions are made only with your consent.
Handover.

For food and meat Orders, the Merchant hands the Order to the Service Partner only after the Service Partner provides the correct pickup code. You must be available at the delivery address. If you are unreachable for 10 minutes after the Service Partner arrives, the Order may be treated as delivered or as cancelled by you under Section 12.
Age-restricted and prohibited products.
Alcohol, tobacco and other restricted products are not sold through the Adios App unless a separate service with Additional Terms is launched in compliance with applicable law.
Vehicle types.
You can book Rides by bike, auto-rickshaw or cab where available. Each Ride is a contract between you and the Service Partner, facilitated by Adios.
Fare estimate and final fare.

Before booking, the Adios App shows an estimated fare based on distance, estimated time, the vehicle type and any demand-based multiplier ("surge") that applies at that time. The final fare may differ from the estimate if the route, distance, travel time or stops change during the Ride, if you request changes, or if tolls, parking or waiting time apply. Applicable charges are shown in the Adios App and on your invoice.
Start PIN.

Each Ride starts only after you share your Ride PIN with the Service Partner. Do not share your PIN before you have confirmed that the vehicle and Service Partner match the details shown in the Adios App.
Your conduct.
You must:
be at the pickup point on time;
not carry more passengers than the vehicle type permits (one pillion passenger on a bike);
wear the helmet provided or your own helmet on a bike Ride, as required by law;
not carry illegal, hazardous or prohibited items;
not ask the Service Partner to break traffic laws;
treat the Service Partner with respect.
You are responsible for any damage you cause to the vehicle beyond normal wear and tear.
Lost items.
Report any item left in a vehicle through support as soon as possible. We will try to connect you with the Service Partner but cannot guarantee recovery.
Regulatory compliance.

Rides are offered only where permitted by applicable law, including the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, the Motor Vehicle Aggregator Guidelines issued by the Government of India, and applicable State rules. We may suspend a vehicle type in any area where it is not permitted.
What you can send.

You may send lawful personal items and documents that fit safely on the vehicle type selected, subject to the limits shown in the Adios App (including a maximum weight of 20 kg for a bike and 50 kg for other vehicle types, and a maximum declared value of ₹2,000).
Prohibited items.
You must not send:
alcohol, drugs, narcotics or psychotropic substances, or tobacco products;
weapons, ammunition, explosives, fireworks or replicas;
flammable, corrosive, toxic, radioactive or otherwise hazardous materials, including gas cylinders;
cash, cheques, gold, jewellery, precious stones or other valuables;
live animals or animal remains;
passports, Aadhaar cards or other identity documents issued by the government, unless they are your own and you accept the risk;
perishable items that may spoil in transit;
anything stolen, counterfeit, pornographic or otherwise illegal, or that requires a permit or licence you do not hold.
Your responsibilities as sender.
You must:
describe the package accurately and pack it securely for transport by two-wheeler or three-wheeler;
provide correct pickup and drop addresses and the names and contact numbers of the persons at each end, with their consent;
share the delivery OTP only with the intended recipient;
ensure that someone is available at both pickup and drop.
Inspection and refusal.

A Service Partner may ask to see the contents of an unsealed package and may refuse to carry any package that appears to contain prohibited items, is unsafe, is poorly packed or exceeds the limits. We may report illegal items to the authorities.
Delivery confirmation.

A Package Delivery is complete when the Service Partner enters the delivery OTP shared by the recipient. Entry of the correct OTP is conclusive evidence that the package was handed over to the recipient, unless you prove otherwise.
Payment at pickup or drop.

You may choose to pay at pickup or at drop. If you choose payment at drop, you confirm that the recipient will pay the amount shown. If the recipient refuses to pay, you remain liable for the Charges.
Failed deliveries.

If the recipient is unavailable, unreachable or refuses the package, the Service Partner will contact you. The package may be returned to the pickup address or held as directed by you, and return and waiting charges shown in the Adios App will apply.
Loss or damage.

Service Partners must take reasonable care of packages. If a package is lost or damaged while in the Service Partner's custody through the Service Partner's fault, you may claim under Section 13. Liability for any single package is limited to the lower of (a) the declared value and (b) ₹2,000. Unless we expressly offer goods-in-transit insurance for your Package Delivery, packages are not insured, and you are advised not to send items that are irreplaceable or worth more than this limit.
Scope.

Helper Bookings let you book a Service Partner for general, non-specialist tasks lasting a selected number of hours, such as shopping, finding items in stores, and picking up or dropping off items (each helper decides which tasks to accept). Helpers do not provide:
work requiring a professional licence or technical qualification (electrical, plumbing, gas, medical, nursing, child care, security, driving your vehicle or similar);
domestic employment or live-in work;
any task that is hazardous, illegal or degrading.
Pricing and offers.

When you request a Helper Booking, the Adios App shows a price range calculated from the hours, the distance involved and any surge. You may propose a price within that range. While we are searching for a helper, you may raise your offer; online price raises are charged as separate payments and are refunded if the booking is cancelled under Section 12. The fare includes a platform fee and applicable taxes, as itemised at checkout.
Start and completion.

A Helper Booking starts only when you share the start OTP with the helper, and is completed when you share the completion PIN. Please do not share these codes until the task has actually started or been completed to your satisfaction.
Your responsibilities.
You must:
describe the task honestly and fully;
provide a safe working environment;
not ask the helper to perform work outside the booked scope or beyond the booked hours without agreeing additional Charges in the Adios App;
not ask the helper to lift loads that are unsafe for one person;
secure your valuables;
not engage the helper directly outside the Adios App for the booked work.
Property and injury.

Helpers must take reasonable care. Report any damage to property or personal injury through support within 24 hours of completion. Adios will investigate and help resolve the matter. Adios's liability is limited as set out in Section 18.
Before you confirm.
The total amount payable and its components are displayed at checkout before you confirm an Order. Depending on the service, the Charges may include:
item prices and packaging charges set by the Merchant;
delivery fees;
the Ride, Package Delivery or Helper fare;
surge or demand-based charges;
waiting, return or toll charges;
platform fees;
tips;
applicable taxes (including GST);
less discounts and coupons.
Surge.
In periods of high demand, a surge multiplier may apply. The applicable surge is reflected in the fare shown before you confirm.
Tips.
Tips are voluntary. 100% of your tip is passed to the Service Partner.
Taxes and invoices.

GST and other taxes are charged as required by law. Invoices for your Order are available in the Adios App. Depending on the service, invoices may be issued by the Merchant, the Service Partner and/or Adios.
Price errors.
If an item or fare is shown at an obviously incorrect price due to a technical or typographical error, we may cancel the affected Order and refund any amount paid in full.
Offers and coupons.

Discounts, coupons and offers are subject to their own Additional Terms, including eligibility, validity, minimum order values and usage limits. They have no cash value and may be withdrawn at any time, but an offer applied to a confirmed Order will be honoured.
Payment methods.
You can pay:
online
through our payment gateway partner, Razorpay, using the methods it offers (such as UPI, debit and credit cards, net banking and wallets); or
in cash
to the Service Partner, where cash is available for that service.
Online payments.

Online payments are processed by Razorpay, a payment aggregator regulated by the Reserve Bank of India, under its own terms and privacy policy. Adios does not receive or store your full card number, CVV, UPI PIN or net banking credentials.
Cash payments.

For cash Orders, you must pay the exact amount shown in the Adios App to the Service Partner on completion. Service Partners are not required to carry change. Do not pay more than the amount shown, and do not pay for Adios Orders outside the Adios App.
Failed or duplicate payments.

If your account is debited but the Order is not confirmed, or you are charged twice, the amount will be reversed to the original payment method, usually within 5 working days. If it is not, contact support.
Outstanding amounts.
If an amount remains unpaid (for example, because a recipient refused to pay at drop, or a cash payment was not made), we may ask you to settle it before placing further Orders.
Cancellation by you.
You may cancel an Order in the Adios App as follows:
Food and meat
Free to cancel: Before the Merchant accepts the Order
If cancelled later: After the Merchant accepts, before the Order is picked up: No refund, unless the Merchant or Adios is at fault (for example, a late, wrong or missing item)
Cannot be cancelled: After the Order is picked up by the Service Partner
Rides
Free to cancel: At any time before the Ride starts
If cancelled later: No cancellation fee
Cannot be cancelled: After the Ride has started
Package Delivery
Free to cancel: At any time before pickup
If cancelled later: No cancellation fee
Cannot be cancelled: After pickup
Helper Bookings
Free to cancel: Before a helper accepts
If cancelled later: After acceptance, before the task starts: No cancellation fee
Cannot be cancelled: After the task has started

No cancellation fee is charged for Rides or Package Deliveries. For a Ride, the Service Partner waits for up to 2 minutes after arriving at the pickup point; if you have not arrived or cannot be reached by then, the Service Partner may cancel the Ride. Any cancellation fee that applies to other services is shown to you in the Adios App before you confirm the cancellation. If we introduce cancellation fees for Rides or Package Deliveries in future, we will give you notice under these Terms and show the fee in the Adios App before you book. Cancellation fees compensate the Merchant or Service Partner for time and costs already incurred.
Cancellation after completion.
An Order cannot be cancelled after it has been delivered or completed. If something went wrong with a completed Order, raise a complaint under Section 13.
Cancellation by the Merchant, Service Partner or Adios.

An Order may be cancelled by the Merchant (for example, if an item is unavailable or the outlet is closed), by the Service Partner (for example, for safety reasons or prohibited items), or by Adios (for example, if no Service Partner is available, for suspected fraud, for price errors, or for reasons beyond our control). If an Order is cancelled for a reason that is not attributable to you, no cancellation fee applies and any online payment is refunded in full.
Cancellations attributable to you.

An Order may be treated as cancelled by you if you provide an incorrect address or contact number, are unreachable or unavailable at the time of delivery or pickup, refuse to accept the Order without valid reason, or send or attempt to send prohibited items.
Repeated cancellations.
We may restrict cash payment or limit the use of the Services for accounts with an unusually high number of cancellations or refused deliveries.
How to raise a complaint.

Report a problem with an Order through "Help" in the Adios App, on the Order screen, or at support@adios.one. To help us resolve it, please raise it within these time limits and provide photographs where relevant:
Missing, wrong, spilled or damaged food items
: report within 2 hours of delivery
Meat quality, freshness, spoilage or weight shortfall
: report within 24 hours of delivery
Ride fare or route disputes
: report within 24 hours of the Ride (72 hours for safety-related or criminal matters)
Package loss, damage or delay
: report within 24 hours of the scheduled delivery
Helper Booking issues, property damage or injury
: report within 24 hours of completion
Payment or refund issues
: report within 30 days of the transaction
Complaints raised after these windows will still be considered, but may be harder to verify.
Investigation.

We will review the information provided by you, the Merchant and the Service Partner, the Order data, Verification Code records and location data, and decide in good faith whether a refund, partial refund, replacement or other resolution is appropriate. We will tell you the outcome and the reasons.
Refund amount and method.
Full refunds are made for Orders cancelled for reasons not attributable to you.
Partial refunds may be made for missing or defective items, weight shortfalls beyond the tolerance, or incorrect fares.
Online payments are refunded to the original payment method within 5–7 working days after the refund is approved. The time taken by your bank or card issuer to credit the amount may vary.
For cash Orders, approved refunds are made by UPI transfer to your verified UPI ID.
Refund status.
The status of any refund (requested, processing, completed or failed) is shown on the Order in the Adios App.
Abuse.
We may refuse refunds where we reasonably believe a claim is false or the account is engaged in refund abuse, and may suspend such accounts under Section 16.
Verification of Merchants and Service Partners.

Merchants are verified at onboarding by reviewing their business, tax and food-safety documents. Service Partners are verified at onboarding by checking their identity (through DigiLocker), PAN and driving licence, and by admin review. Service Partners also undergo police or third-party background verification before approval. Verification reduces risk but does not guarantee the conduct of any person.
In-trip safety features.
The Adios App provides:
live tracking of your Ride or delivery;
the Service Partner's name, photograph and vehicle type;
Ride PINs and delivery and helper codes;
in-app chat;
an

Pressing SOS during an active Order alerts the Adios safety team, who will attempt to contact you and take appropriate action. Hours: during our support hours, which are 24x7.
SOS is not a substitute for the emergency services. In an emergency, call 112 (national emergency number) immediately.
Zero tolerance.

We do not tolerate violence, harassment (including sexual harassment), discrimination, threats or abuse by anyone using the Adios platform. Report any incident through the Adios App or at ________. We may suspend accounts while we investigate and will cooperate with law enforcement.

You may rate and review Merchants and Service Partners after an Order. Reviews must be honest, based on your own experience and comply with the content rules in the Terms of Use. We may moderate or remove reviews that breach those rules. We do not pay for reviews, and Merchants and Service Partners may not offer you anything in exchange for a review.

You may stop using the Adios App at any time and may request deletion of your account as described in the Privacy Policy. Outstanding amounts and pending refunds or complaints will be settled first.
By us.
We may warn you, restrict features (such as cash payment), suspend or terminate your account, with notice where practicable, if:
